fullText.simplified:
四、雪山的山洞

    六天了，饭饭爬了六天了，他还没有爬到雪山的最上面。
    他看不到山的最上面，不知道那上面有没有大雕和小白。他也看不到山的后面，不知道那后面有没有去往猫乐园的路。
    有时候，他站在山的中间往下看。每看一次，他的心就会害怕一次。因为真的太高了，他看不到地面。他想起了小白的话：“你没有上去过，不知道那上面有多高。如果你去看一眼，就会知道什么是害怕了。”
    小白上来过，他知道雪山这儿有多高，他也害怕了，但他还是来了。他不是为了去猫乐园吃好吃的东西吧？他是因为知道我一个人走不到猫乐园，所以和我一起来了吧？他是想帮我吧？饭饭在心里想。
    饭饭又走了两天，越往上面越难走，他的腿和脚都很累。雪越来越厚，天气也越来越冷。山上没有吃的东西，饭饭只能喝雪水。
    这天晚上，山间开始刮风。饭饭太累了，他睡在了雪地里。
    不知道睡了多长时间，饭饭听到了鸟飞过的声音。天上有月亮，饭饭看清楚了，是抓走小白的那只大雕，他正在往上飞。
    饭饭马上站了起来，他跟着大雕的方向往上爬。
    他飞快地爬着，他不怕被大雕发现，他只想知道大雕会飞去哪儿。一会儿后，大雕下来了，他飞到一块石头的后面，然后不见了。
    饭饭爬过去，发现那儿有个山洞，大雕飞进山洞了。
    这个山洞就是大雕的家吗？
    洞口很黑，看不清里面，饭饭小心地往里走。里面没有雪，也不冷。走了一会儿，他看到那只大雕了。
    大雕正睡在一块大石头上。大石头旁边，睡着一只大猫，那是小白。
fullText.traditional:
四、雪山的山洞

    六天了，飯飯爬了六天了，他還沒有爬到雪山的最上面。
    他看不到山的最上面，不知道那上面有沒有大鵰和小白。他也看不到山的後面，不知道那後面有沒有去往貓樂園的路。
    有時候，他站在山的中間往下看。每看一次，他的心就會害怕一次。因為真的太高了，他看不到地面。他想起了小白的話：“你沒有上去過，不知道那上面有多高。如果你去看一眼，就會知道什麼是害怕了。”
    小白上來過，他知道雪山這兒有多高，他也害怕了，但他還是來了。他不是為了去貓樂園吃好吃的東西吧？他是因為知道我一個人走不到貓樂園，所以和我一起來了吧？他是想幫我吧？飯飯在心裡想。
    飯飯又走了兩天，越往上面越難走，他的腿和腳都很累。雪越來越厚，天氣也越來越冷。山上沒有吃的東西，飯飯只能喝雪水。
    這天晚上，山間開始颳風。飯飯太累了，他睡在了雪地裡。
    不知道睡了多長時間，飯飯聽到了鳥飛過的聲音。天上有月亮，飯飯看清楚了，是抓走小白的那隻大鵰，他正在往上飛。
    飯飯馬上站了起來，他跟著大鵰的方向往上爬。
    他飛快地爬著，他不怕被大鵰發現，他只想知道大鵰會飛去哪兒。一會兒後，大鵰下來了，他飛到一塊石頭的後面，然後不見了。
    飯飯爬過去，發現那兒有個山洞，大鵰飛進山洞了。
    這個山洞就是大鵰的家嗎？
    洞口很黑，看不清裡面，飯飯小心地往裡走。裡面沒有雪，也不冷。走了一會兒，他看到那隻大鵰了。
    大鵰正睡在一塊大石頭上。大石頭旁邊，睡著一隻大貓，那是小白。

sentences.simplified: 六天了，饭饭爬了六天了，他还没有爬到雪山的最上面。
sentences.traditional: 六天了，飯飯爬了六天了，他還沒有爬到雪山的最上面。
sentences.pinyin: liù tiān le fàn fàn pá le liù tiān le tā hái méi yǒu pá dào xuě shān de zuì shàng miàn
sentences.english: It had been six days. Fanfan climbed for six days, but he had not yet reached the top of the snowy mountain.

sentences.simplified: 他看不到山的最上面，不知道那上面有没有大雕和小白。
sentences.traditional: 他看不到山的最上面，不知道那上面有沒有大鵰和小白。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn bú dào shān de zuì shàng miàn bù zhī dào nà shàng miàn yǒu méi yǒu dà diāo hé xiǎo bái
sentences.english: He couldn’t see the top of the mountain and didn’t know if the big eagle and Little Bai would be at the top.

sentences.simplified: 他也看不到山的后面，不知道那后面有没有去往猫乐园的路。
sentences.traditional: 他也看不到山的後面，不知道那後面有沒有去往貓樂園的路。
sentences.pinyin: tā yě kàn bú dào shān de hòu miàn bù zhī dào nà hòu miàn yǒu méi yǒu qù wǎng māo lè yuán de lù
sentences.english: He also couldn’t see behind the mountain and didn’t know if there was a road leading to the cat paradise.

sentences.simplified: 有时候，他站在山的中间往下看。
sentences.traditional: 有時候，他站在山的中間往下看。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hou tā zhàn zài shān de zhōng jiān wǎng xià kàn
sentences.english: There were times when he stood halfway up the mountain and looked down.

sentences.simplified: 每看一次，他的心就会害怕一次。因为真的太高了，他看不到地面。
sentences.traditional: 每看一次，他的心就會害怕一次。因為真的太高了，他看不到地面。
sentences.pinyin: měi kàn yí cì tā de xīn jiù huì hài pà yí cì yīn wèi zhēn de tài gāo le tā kàn bú dào dì miàn
sentences.english: Every time he looked, he would get scared. This was because it was really high up, and he couldn’t see the ground.

sentences.simplified: 他想起了小白的话：
sentences.traditional: 他想起了小白的話：
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng qǐ le xiǎo bái de huà
sentences.english: He remembered Little Bai’s words:

sentences.simplified: “你没有上去过，不知道那上面有多高。如果你去看一眼，就会知道什么是害怕了。”
sentences.traditional: “你沒有上去過，不知道那上面有多高。如果你去看一眼，就會知道什麼是害怕了。”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ méi yǒu shàng qù guò bù zhī dào nà shàng miàn yǒu duō gāo rú guǒ nǐ qù kàn yì yǎn jiù huì zhī dào shén me shì hài pà le
sentences.english: “You haven’t been up there. You don’t know how high it is up there. If you go there and have a look, you’ll know what fear is.”

sentences.simplified: 小白上来过，他知道雪山这儿有多高，他也害怕了，但他还是来了。
sentences.traditional: 小白上來過，他知道雪山這兒有多高，他也害怕了，但他還是來了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái shàng lái guò tā zhī dào xuě shān zhè‘r yǒu duō gāo tā yě hài pà le dàn tā hái shi lái le
sentences.english: Little Bai had been up here before. He knew how high the snowy mountain was. He was also afraid, but he still came.

sentences.simplified: 他不是为了去猫乐园吃好吃的东西吧？
sentences.traditional: 他不是為了去貓樂園吃好吃的東西吧？
sentences.pinyin: tā bú shì wèi le qù māo lè yuán chī hǎo chī de dōng xi ba
sentences.english: He isn’t going to the cat paradise just for the delicious food, is he?

sentences.simplified: 他是因为知道我一个人走不到猫乐园，所以和我一起来了吧？
sentences.traditional: 他是因為知道我一個人走不到貓樂園，所以和我一起來了吧？
sentences.pinyin: tā shì yīn wèi zhī dào wǒ yí ge rén zǒu bú dào māo lè yuán suǒ yǐ hé wǒ yì qǐ lái le ba
sentences.english: He came with me because he knew I couldn’t get to the cat paradise on my own, right?

sentences.simplified: 他是想帮我吧？饭饭在心里想。
sentences.traditional: 他是想幫我吧？飯飯在心裡想。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì xiǎng bāng wǒ ba fàn fàn zài xīn li xiǎng
sentences.english: He wants to help me, right? Fanfan thought to himself.

sentences.simplified: 饭饭又走了两天，越往上面越难走，他的腿和脚都很累。
sentences.traditional: 飯飯又走了兩天，越往上面越難走，他的腿和腳都很累。
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn yòu zǒu le liǎng tiān yuè wǎng shàng miàn yuè nán zǒu tā de tuǐ hé jiǎo dōu hěn lèi
sentences.english: Fanfan walked for another two days. The further up he went, the harder it became to walk. His legs and feet were very tired.

sentences.simplified: 雪越来越厚，天气也越来越冷。
sentences.traditional: 雪越來越厚，天氣也越來越冷。
sentences.pinyin: xuě yuè lái yuè hòu tiān qì yě yuè lái yuè lěng
sentences.english: The snow was getting thicker, and the weather was getting colder.

sentences.simplified: 山上没有吃的东西，饭饭只能喝雪水。
sentences.traditional: 山上沒有吃的東西，飯飯只能喝雪水。
sentences.pinyin: shān shang méi yǒu chī de dōng xi fàn fàn zhǐ néng hē xuě shuǐ
sentences.english: There was no food on the mountain, so Fanfan could only drink snow water.

sentences.simplified: 这天晚上，山间开始刮风。饭饭太累了，他睡在了雪地里。
sentences.traditional: 這天晚上，山間開始颳風。飯飯太累了，他睡在了雪地裡。
sentences.pinyin: zhè tiān wǎn shang shān jiān kāi shǐ guā fēng fàn fàn tài lèi le tā shuì zài le xuě dì lǐ
sentences.english: That night, the wind began to blow on the mountain. Fanfan was too tired. He fell asleep in the snow.

sentences.simplified: 不知道睡了多长时间，饭饭听到了鸟飞过的声音。
sentences.traditional: 不知道睡了多長時間，飯飯聽到了鳥飛過的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī dào shuì le duō cháng shí jiān fàn fàn tīng dào le niǎo fēi guò de shēng yīn
sentences.english: Fanfan didn’t know how long he had slept when he heard the sound of birds flying by.

sentences.simplified: 天上有月亮，饭饭看清楚了，是抓走小白的那只大雕，他正在往上飞。
sentences.traditional: 天上有月亮，飯飯看清楚了，是抓走小白的那隻大鵰，他正在往上飛。
sentences.pinyin: tiān shàng yǒu yuè liang fàn fàn kàn qīng chu le shì zhuā zǒu xiǎo bái de nà zhī dà diāo tā zhèng zài wǎng shàng fēi
sentences.english: The moon was in the sky, and Fanfan saw that it was the big eagle that took Little Bai away, flying upwards.

sentences.simplified: 饭饭马上站了起来，他跟着大雕的方向往上爬。
sentences.traditional: 飯飯馬上站了起來，他跟著大鵰的方向往上爬。
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn mǎ shàng zhàn le qǐ lái tā gēn zhe dà diāo de fāng xiàng wǎng shàng pá
sentences.english: Fanfan immediately stood up. He began climbing upwards, following the direction of the big eagle.

sentences.simplified: 他飞快地爬着，
sentences.traditional: 他飛快地爬著，
sentences.pinyin: tā fēi kuài de pá zhe
sentences.english: He climbed extremely quickly.

sentences.simplified: 他不怕被大雕发现，他只想知道大雕会飞去哪儿。
sentences.traditional: 他不怕被大鵰發現，他只想知道大鵰會飛去哪兒。
sentences.pinyin: tā bú pà bèi dà diāo fā xiàn tā zhǐ xiǎng zhī dào dà diāo huì fēi qù nǎ'r
sentences.english: He was not afraid of being spotted by the big eagle. He just wanted to know where the big eagle was flying to.

sentences.simplified: 一会儿后，大雕下来了，他飞到一块石头的后面，然后不见了。
sentences.traditional: 一會兒後，大鵰下來了，他飛到一塊石頭的後面，然後不見了。
sentences.pinyin: yí huì'r hòu dà diāo xià lai le tā fēi dào yí kuài shí tou de hòu miàn rán hòu bú jiàn le
sentences.english: After a while, the big eagle descended. He flew behind a rock and then disappeared.

sentences.simplified: 饭饭爬过去，发现那儿有个山洞，大雕飞进山洞了。
sentences.traditional: 飯飯爬過去，發現那兒有個山洞，大鵰飛進山洞了。
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn pá guò qu fā xiàn nà'r yǒu ge shān dòng dà diāo fēi jìn shān dòng le
sentences.english: Fanfan climbed over and discovered a cave there. The big eagle had flown into the cave.

sentences.simplified: 这个山洞就是大雕的家吗？
sentences.traditional: 這個山洞就是大鵰的家嗎？
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shān dòng jiù shì dà diāo de jiā ma
sentences.english: Was this cave the big eagle’s home?

sentences.simplified: 洞口很黑，看不清里面，饭饭小心地往里走。
sentences.traditional: 洞口很黑，看不清裡面，飯飯小心地往裡走。
sentences.pinyin: dòng kǒu hěn hēi kàn bù qīng lǐ miàn fàn fàn xiǎo xīn de wǎng lǐ zǒu
sentences.english: The entrance was very dark, making it difficult to see inside. Fanfan cautiously walked in.

sentences.simplified: 里面没有雪，也不冷。走了一会儿，他看到那只大雕了。
sentences.traditional: 裡面沒有雪，也不冷。走了一會兒，他看到那隻大鵰了。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ miàn méi yǒu xuě yě bù lěng zǒu le yí huì'r tā kàn dào nà zhī dà diāo le
sentences.english: There was no snow inside, and it was not cold. After walking for a while, he saw the big eagle.

sentences.simplified: 大雕正睡在一块大石头上。大石头旁边，睡着一只大猫，那是小白。
sentences.traditional: 大鵰正睡在一塊大石頭上。大石頭旁邊，睡著一隻大貓，那是小白。
sentences.pinyin: dà diāo zhèng shuì zài yí kuài dà shí tou shang dà shí tou páng biān shuì zháo yì zhī dà māo nà shì xiǎo bái
sentences.english: The big eagle was sleeping on a big rock. Next to the big rock, there was a big cat sleeping. It was Little Bai.

sentence_translations: (4) The Cave in the Snowy Mountain
It had been six days. Fanfan climbed for six days, but he had not yet reached the top of the snowy mountain.
He couldn’t see the top of the mountain and didn’t know if the big eagle and Little Bai would be at the top.
He also couldn’t see behind the mountain and didn’t know if there was a road leading to the cat paradise.
There were times when he stood halfway up the mountain and looked down.
Every time he looked, he would get scared. This was because it was really high up, and he couldn’t see the ground.
He remembered Little Bai’s words:
“You haven’t been up there. You don’t know how high it is up there. If you go there and have a look, you’ll know what fear is.”
Little Bai had been up here before. He knew how high the snowy mountain was. He was also afraid, but he still came.
He isn’t going to the cat paradise just for the delicious food, is he?
He came with me because he knew I couldn’t get to the cat paradise on my own, right?
He wants to help me, right? Fanfan thought to himself.
Fanfan walked for another two days. The further up he went, the harder it became to walk. His legs and feet were very tired.
The snow was getting thicker, and the weather was getting colder.
There was no food on the mountain, so Fanfan could only drink snow water.
That night, the wind began to blow on the mountain. Fanfan was too tired. He fell asleep in the snow.
Fanfan didn’t know how long he had slept when he heard the sound of birds flying by.
The moon was in the sky, and Fanfan saw that it was the big eagle that took Little Bai away, flying upwards.
Fanfan immediately stood up. He began climbing upwards, following the direction of the big eagle.
He climbed extremely quickly.
He was not afraid of being spotted by the big eagle. He just wanted to know where the big eagle was flying to.
After a while, the big eagle descended. He flew behind a rock and then disappeared.
Fanfan climbed over and discovered a cave there. The big eagle had flown into the cave.
Was this cave the big eagle’s home?
The entrance was very dark, making it difficult to see inside. Fanfan cautiously walked in.
There was no snow inside, and it was not cold. After walking for a while, he saw the big eagle.
The big eagle was sleeping on a big rock. Next to the big rock, there was a big cat sleeping. It was Little Bai.
